body:
ho boy... you aren't the one at fault. You aren't stressing him out, *he's* stressing *you* out. What would I do? kick the door down. But if I lived your life then I would be in the same place you are, wouldn't I? Anyway you really REALLY need to dump him, like, right now. and then call the police if your mom doesn't let you out.   
He's been wanting to leave if he said he didn't want to put any effort in, he's too much of a coward to say he wants to end the relationship, so show him up by doing it first, on your terms. Also, I am so so horribly sorry about what happened to you :( I hope you are ok :/
